name: Gifd App Builder
description: Customize Gifd's apps from chat. The agent edits code in a draft sandbox; user accepts or discards.

groundworkRoot.description: Absolute path to the groundwork-web app directory. Defaults to the workspace's apps/groundwork-web.

draftsRoot.description: Absolute path where draft worktrees are created. Defaults to <tmp>/gifd-drafts.

codegen.description: Model used for code generation in drafts.

clarify.description: Model used for fast clarifying-question turns.

perSessionUsd.description: Hard cap on LLM spend per draft session, in USD.
